observations: Photo 0 shows a removed car engine assembly on the ground (intake/airbox visible, wiring harness, turbo/engine bay components not fully identifiable).
Photo 1 shows the same engine from another angle; multiple hoses/wiring and metal housings are visible; no clear engine code plate is readable.
Photo 2 shows the top/side of the engine with an airbox/intake cover and wiring; again no clearly readable model/engine code.

claims.claim: We also deals in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos show an engine assembly but do not prove the business scope.

risks.risk: Engine model/variant is not readable from the photos, so the exact match to the comparable listings (and correct pricing) is uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate or stamped code on the engine block (and the transmission code if included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch: treat as an unknown complete engine with no verified compatibility.

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (photos show a used/removed engine, but no test/verification).
risks.proof: A short video of a cold-start/test run (or compression test / leak-down test results) plus a photo of any warranty/receipt if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: assume it may be faulty).

risks.risk: Completeness is uncertain (some parts may be missing: sensors, brackets, hoses, turbo/ancillaries, or wiring connectors).
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo/video showing every included component, and close-ups of connectors/ports to confirm nothing is missing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts may be missing.

risks.risk: Damage during removal/transport is possible (visible grime/rust and the engine is on the ground; internal damage cannot be seen).
risks.proof: Close-ups of any cracks/impact points and photos of the oil pan, timing cover area, and mounting points; plus test results if possible.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/ID plate or stamped engine code on the block (and transmission code if attached).
Proof of working condition: compression/leak-down results or a short start/test video.
Photos/video confirming completeness: show all sensors/hoses/connectors and any missing parts.
Close-ups of suspected damage areas (oil pan, mounting points, timing cover area) with a brief explanation.
response.reason: The photos show a complete engine assembly, but the exact engine model/variant and working/completeness status are not verifiable from the images. Without the engine code and proof it runs, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the comparables.
